# The Spanish Study

> > Interactive online platform for learning Spanish through exercises covering verb conjugations, grammar, and vocabulary with audio support in English and Danish.

The Spanish Study offers comprehensive Spanish language learning resources with interactive exercises for all proficiency levels. The platform provides bilingual support in English and Danish, featuring structured practice in verb conjugations, grammar rules, vocabulary building, and audio pronunciation exercises.

## Key Topics

- Spanish verb conjugation
- Interactive language exercises
- Spanish grammar practice
- Vocabulary word lists
- Audio pronunciation exercises
- Danish-Spanish learning
- Reflexive verbs
- Object pronouns
- Conditional tense
- Gerundio forms
- Spanish numbers
- Common verbs (gustar, querer, tener, haber, hacer)
- Online study settings
- Language learning platform

## Main Learning Platform

- [Spanish language | online exercises](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/EN/spanish-language-online-exercises.asp): Main Spanish learning platform with exercises for all levels
- [Spansk sprog | online øvelser](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/spansk-sprog-online-oevelser.asp): Danish: Main Spanish language learning platform with full exercises

## Verb Conjugation Exercises

- [Spanish verb conjugations | online exercises](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/EN/spanish-verbs-conjugations-online-exercises.asp): Comprehensive Spanish verb conjugation exercises for all levels
- [The conjugation of querer | online Spanish](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/EN/querer-conjugation-spanish-verbs-online-exercises.asp): Interactive exercises for conjugating Spanish verb 'querer'
- [Lær bøjningen af querer | online spansk](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/querer-boejning-spansk-verbum-online-oevelser.asp): Danish: Conjugation exercises for Spanish verb 'querer'
- [Lær bøjningen af tener | online spansk](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/tener-boejning-spansk-verbum-online-oevelser.asp): Danish: Conjugation exercises for Spanish verb 'tener'
- [Lær bøjningen af haber | online spansk](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/haber-boejning-spansk-verbum-online-oevelser.asp): Danish: Conjugation exercises for Spanish verb 'haber'
- [Lær bøjningen af hacer | online spansk](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/hacer-boejning-spansk-verbum-online-oevelser.asp): Danish: Conjugation exercises for Spanish verb 'hacer'
- [Spanske refleksive verber | online øvelser](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/spanske-refleksive-verber-boejning-online-oevelser.asp): Danish: Spanish reflexive verbs conjugation with audio exercises
- [Spansk condicional bøjning | online øvelser](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/spansk-condicional-online-oevelser.asp): Danish: Spanish conditional tense conjugation exercises
- [Spansk gerundio | online øvelser](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/spansk-gerundio-online-oevelser.asp): Danish: Spanish gerundio (estar + gerund) exercises

## Grammar Practice

- [Spanish double object pronouns | online grammar exercises](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/EN/spanish-double-object-pronouns-online-exercises.asp): Grammar exercises for Spanish double object pronouns
- [Spanish direct object pronouns | online grammar exercises](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/EN/spanish-direct-object-pronouns-accusative.asp): Grammar exercises for Spanish direct object pronouns
- [Gustar | Online exercises on the Spanish verb gustar](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/EN/gustar-spanish-verb-exercises.asp): Interactive exercises for Spanish verb 'gustar' usage
- [Gustar | Online øvelser med det spanske verbum gustar](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/gustar-spansk-verbum-oevelser.asp): Danish: Interactive exercises for Spanish verb 'gustar'

## Vocabulary & Word Lists

- [Spanish vocab | online word lists](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/EN/spanish-vocab-online-word-lists-exercises.asp): Spanish vocabulary word lists and practice exercises
- [Spanske gloser | online lister](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/spanske-gloser-online-lister-oevelser.asp): Danish: Spanish vocabulary lists with audio exercises

- [Lær tallene på spansk | online spansk](https://www.thespanishstudy.com/DK/spanske-tal-online-oevelser-tallene-paa-spansk.asp): Danish: Learn Spanish numbers with audio exercises
